summary: Single piezo counter on a low-volume offramp path (about 20-30 bikes/day). From Feb 2017 to Apr 2019 it recorded only in short windows from around Friday noon and published zeros otherwise (the adjacent site 92 shows the same pattern), so those periods are set missing, as are several multi-day dry-weather outages. The big rises in Jan-Mar 2025 and Aug-Sep 2025 are real detours while the main path at site 92 was closed, and rain-day zeros are kept.
